text:
marta: heads-up — hit a customer case where the Python SDK retried a POST upload after a transient 502 and created duplicate jobs. tiny repro below and a few proposed fixes.

marta: repro code:
```py
# redwood==0.9.3
with open('bigstream.bin','rb') as f:
    resp = client.ingest.create_job(model='embed-1', file=f)
    print(resp)
```
Server intermittently returns 502; SDK transport retries, but second attempt sends empty body for non-seekable streams so server accepts it as a new job (no Idempotency-Key). Customer saw two job ids.

noah: yikes. do we add Idempotency-Key automatically for uploads?

marta: currently no. transport-level retries are blind to body reusability.

jin: classic streamed-body + retry problem. Options: (1) require Idempotency-Key on mutating endpoints, (2) add opt-in buffering so we can rewind, (3) special-case large uploads to tempfile and replay from disk.

noah: prefer opt-in buffering plus a helper to create keys. For example `client.helpers.make_idempotency(stream)` which can use content-length or a short sha256 of prefix.

marta: PoC in a branch: config under `client.retries`: `stream_buffering.enabled`, `stream_buffering.max_bytes`, `stream_buffering.mode` where mode is `fail|memory|tempfile`. Behavior: if stream.seekable() -> rewind; elif small -> buffer to BytesIO; elif mode=="tempfile" -> write to NamedTemporaryFile; else raise error asking for Idempotency-Key.

jin: naming bikeshed: `stream_buffering` reads nicely. Also add telemetry `sdk.stream_buffered` with size and mode.

docs-bot: docs note: quickstart upload example should show explicit Idempotency-Key pattern and mention helper. Also include an upgrade note for 0.9.4 (opt-in buffering). Example snippet: ```py
key = client.helpers.make_idempotency_for(fh)
resp = client.ingest.create_job(..., headers={'Idempotency-Key': key})
```

noah: tests: simulate flaky 502s, assert single job when buffering enabled; unit test for non-seekable stream raising on second read. Also integration with staging that injects 502.

marta: added warning log when we auto-buffer: "SDK buffered non-seekable body (mode=tempfile, size=XYZ) to allow safe retry" so SRE/customers can see it.

jin: also consider context manager sugar: `with client.stream_buffering(enabled=True):` for per-call control.

marta: PR incoming. will default to disabled, opt-in, until we collect telemetry. changelog blurb: "Add opt-in stream buffering to support safe retries for non-seekable request bodies; recommend Idempotency-Key for large uploads."

ci-bot: CI started for branch marta/stream-buffering (unit tests + lint)

ci-bot: CI passed — 46 tests, 0 failures

noah: great. once PR is up i'll review and we can merge after docs are ready.
